product_one_liner.value: Trackforce provides a connected physical-security operations platform for security companies and enterprise security teams to manage sites, shifts, guards, incidents, reporting, and operational intelligence.

pricing_page.notes: Pricing is quote-based, but the company has a dedicated pricing page.

employee_band.notes: The cited company profile reports 426 employees and a 201-500 company-size band.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index presents security-operations, product, and buyer-oriented articles, not at least two engineering posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Trackforce links to a searchable support/help center with how-to, troubleshooting, setup, developer-tools, and release-note sections.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers page lists two open roles—Enterprise Sales Director and Major Accounts Account Manager—and neither is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed product, help, security, blog, and public materials describe AI features but do not publicly identify a model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Only requested certification/compliance names explicitly claimed on the trust page are listed; ISO 27017 is not one of the five requested categories.

last_funding.notes: K1 announced its investment on September 3, 2019 and stated it committed over $150 million; the funding profile identifies the round as Series B/private equity.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round is dated 2019-09, before the 18-month window preceding 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board is open and lists sales roles, but none is titled SDR, BDR, business-development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 27, 2026 Trackforce publicly described Margin Insight as a new feature; the product page describes the feature.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Trackforce announced Scott Kaine's appointment as CEO on January 12, 2026, within the 12-month window.
